# Non-Binding Letter of Intent

**Buyer:** Zhi Yuan Guo Liau
**Seller:** Ray Dunlap, owner of Suds City Coin Laundry
**Target:** Suds City Coin Laundry, 4417 S Peoria Ave, Tulsa, OK 74105
**Date:** September 12, 2026

## 1. Proposed consideration
Purchase price of **$1,041,800** for 100 percent of the assets, derived from the exchange's last clearing price of $104.18 per share across 10,000 shares.

## 2. Structure
Asset purchase. Buyer acquires the equipment, leasehold improvements, customer lists, and trade name free of liens. Buyer does not assume liabilities except the premises lease, subject to landlord consent.

## 3. Diligence period
45 days from execution, during which Seller grants access to three years of tax returns, coin and card revenue reports, utility bills, equipment service records, and the premises lease.

## 4. Exclusivity
Seller agrees not to solicit competing offers for 30 days from execution.

## 5. Non-binding
This letter states intent only and creates no obligation to complete a transaction, except sections 4 and 6.

## 6. Confidentiality
Both parties keep the existence and terms of this letter confidential.

---
_Play money. Not legal advice._

checklist.item: Obtain landlord consent to lease assignment
checklist.why: A coin laundry's value is tied to the site. An assignment clause that lets the landlord refuse or reset rent can erase the multiple.

checklist.item: Run a UCC-1 lien search on the equipment with the Oklahoma County Clerk
checklist.why: Washers and dryers are commonly financed. Liens survive an asset sale unless released at closing.

citation.title: Oklahoma Secretary of State, UCC filings

checklist.item: Transfer the Oklahoma sales tax permit and confirm no outstanding liability
checklist.why: Oklahoma can hold a successor liable for the seller's unpaid sales tax. Request a tax clearance letter before funding.

checklist.item: Verify water and sewer account history and any municipal backflow inspection
checklist.why: Water is the largest variable cost. Twelve months of bills validate the claimed utilization and margin.

citation.title: City of Tulsa Water and Sewer
